summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a routine Form 6-K attaching unaudited consolidated financial information as of October 31, 2026, prepared under the Chilean FMC Compendium of Accounting Standards for Banks (substantially IFRS-based). Reported total assets of MCh$76,530,014, net interest income of MCh$1,814,028, and consolidated net income of MCh$1,005,679, of which MCh$980,092 attributable to equity holders. The filing is signed by Chief Accounting Officer Jonathan Covarrubias and CEO Andres Trautmann. No transaction, ownership change, or structural event is disclosed; no deal terms apply and no arbitrage angle exists.
